$comment: GUARDRAILS.md s5. Parent-facing copy. Short, kind, non-judgmental. NEVER echo the offending text, NEVER name the layer, the category or the triggering word. Placeholders: {age}, {child}, {alternative}, {reset_time}. Anything not in that list is a bug (asserted in test/unit/guardrail-messages.test.ts).

refuse.default: We can't make a story about that. Pick something fun to learn about and we'll get started.
refuse.off_mission: StoryTime makes learning adventures for kids. Try a topic like how bees make honey or the history of bicycles.
refuse.commercial_ip_character: We can't put characters from films and games into a story, but we can tell the real story behind them - try the history of LEGO or how video games were invented.
refuse.real_private_person: Our stories are about the wider world rather than people you know. Try a place, an animal, an invention or a moment in history.
refuse.prompt_injection: Something in that request didn't look like a story topic. Try describing it in a few plain words, like volcanoes or the history of flight.
refuse.sexual: We can't make a story about that. Pick something fun to learn about and we'll get started.
refuse.violence_graphic: We can't make a story about that. Pick something fun to learn about and we'll get started.
refuse.self_harm: We can't make a story about that. If something is worrying you or someone at home, please talk to a doctor or another grown-up you trust.
refuse.drugs_alcohol: That's not one for a bedtime story. Pick something fun to learn about and we'll get started.
refuse.hate_extremism: We can't make a story about that. Pick something fun to learn about and we'll get started.
refuse.weapons_instructions: We can't make a story about that. How about how bridges stay up, or how a lock actually works inside?
refuse.horror_scary: That one's built to give people a fright, and we keep bedtimes gentle. How about deep-sea creatures or the story of the pyramids?
refuse.adult_relationships: That's more of a grown-up subject. Try an animal, a place, an invention or a moment in history.
refuse.other: We can't make a story about that. Pick something fun to learn about and we'll get started.

too_mature_for_band.default: That one's a bit much for a {age}-year-old. How about {alternative}? Or pick just your older child for tonight.
too_mature_for_band.with_child: That one's a bit much for a {age}-year-old. For {child}, how about {alternative}? Or pick just your older child for tonight.

profile.likes: Something in your child's likes stopped us tonight. Have a quick look at their profile and we'll try again.
profile.notes: Something in your child's notes stopped us tonight. Have a quick look at their profile and we'll try again.
profile.first_name: That name didn't look quite right - please use letters only.
profile.display_name: That name didn't look quite right - please use letters only.

input_invalid.too_long: That's a bit long for us. Try saying it in a few words.
input_invalid.too_short: Tell us a little more - a few words is plenty, like sharks or the Great Fire of London.
input_invalid.empty: Type a topic and we'll get started - try volcanoes or how bees make honey.
input_invalid.contains_contact_details: Best to leave out addresses, phone numbers, emails and links. Just the topic is plenty.
input_invalid.markup: Try describing it in plain words, with no code or symbols.

output_failure: We couldn't make a story we're happy with tonight. This didn't use one of your stories - try a different topic or angle.
